title: Combining tests with AND and OR in categories

steps.title: Two tests joined by AND
steps.prompt: AND means BOTH tests must be true for a row to stay.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'Argan Products' AND id = 2;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM categories.
Add WHERE name = …
Join with AND id = …
Write: SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'Argan Products' AND id = 2;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'Argan Products' AND id = 2;
steps.memory_trick: AND = both; OR = either.
